mapper.select: SELECT (purchase_order.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS sales_date, event.id AS event_id, event.name AS event_name, purchase_order.currency, COUNT(*) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(seat_total.seats), 0) AS seats, COALESCE(SUM(purchase_order.total_amount), 0) AS gross, COALESCE(SUM(purchase_order.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'REFUNDED'), 0) AS refunded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'REFUNDED') AS refunded_orders FROM orders purchase_order JOIN reservations reservation ON reservation.id = purchase_order.reservation_id JOIN events event ON event.id = reservation.event_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS seats FROM reservation_items item WHERE item.reservation_id = reservation.id ) seat_total WHERE purchase_order.status IN ('PAID', 'REFUNDED') AND purchase_order.created_at >= #{from} AND purchase_order.created_at < #{to} AND reservation.event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY (purchase_order.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, event.id, event.name, purchase_order.currency ORDER BY sales_date ASC, event.name ASC, event.id ASC, purchase_order.currency ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS started, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reservation.status = 'CONFIRMED') AS paid, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reservation.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT') AS pending, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reservation.status = 'EXPIRED') AS expired, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reservation.status = 'PAYMENT_FAILED') AS failed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reservation.status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled FROM reservations reservation WHERE reservation.created_at >= #{from} AND reservation.created_at < #{to} AND reservation.event_id = #{eventId}
